en.html:
At her words, I looked up from the document in my hands.

Through the car window: the escort vehicles alongside, the passing streets—and beyond them, an unmoving grandeur rising above everything.

Indeed, close now.
...Come to think of it, my first sight of it from such a distance.

The heart of the Rokuhara shogunate————Fudaraku Fortress.

言われて、俺は掌中の書面から目を離した。

　車の窓越しに景色を眺める。
　併走する警護車両、流れ去ってゆく街路――そして
その向こうに<ruby>聳<rt>そび</rt></ruby>える、不動の偉容。

　確かに、もう近い。
　……これ程の距離で目にするのは、思えば初めての
事であった。

　六波羅幕府の中核点――――普陀楽城塞。

en.html:
Chachamaru"Apun came all this way, nobody to receive her. Cold people, you lot."
獅子吼"Nobody called you."
Raichou"Seconded."
童心"No, no, no, no. Your arrival was so sudden... Had you informed us beforehand, naturally no such discourtesy would have occurred."
童心"In any case, welcome back. Doushin feels he has gained the strength of a hundred men."
Raichou"The obstruction of a hundred men, you mean."
獅子吼"If a hundred will cover it."
Chachamaru"Better budget for two hundred."
Raichou"Quite so! Ohohohoho!"
Raichou"NO, NOT QUITE SO! No intention of being useful from the beginning, have you!"
Chachamaru"Agree with this one, still get shouted at... Difficult child, same as ever."
童心"Now, now. After so long, all Four Kubou together."
童心"For today, let us celebrate the reunion."
獅子吼"Very well. This also is politics."
獅子吼"How fortunate."
Raichou"Indeed."
Chachamaru"Maybe these people actually have no capacity whatsoever for standing above other humans."
童心"Now, now. ............Dear me."
童心"But, Chachamaru ji. There is something I would ask."
Chachamaru"Hm?"
獅子吼"Yes. I also wanted to ask. ...Who is that?"

茶々丸 「来てやったってのに誰も出迎えに来ねえ。 　寒いんだよ、てめーら」
獅子吼 「呼んでいない」
雷蝶 「右に同じ」
童心 「いやいやいやいや。 　あまりに突然のご登城であったゆえ……前 もってお知らせ下さっていればこんな無礼は 致さなかったのでござるが」
童心 「ともかく、よくぞお戻り下された。 　この童心坊、百人力を得た心地でござる」
雷蝶 「百人分の足手まといの間違いでしょうに」
獅子吼 「百人分で済めば良いが」
茶々丸 「二百人分は覚悟しといた方がいいな」

雷蝶 「じゃァないでしょ!? 　端から役に立つ気がないのかあんたは!!」
茶々丸 「話を合わせてやったのに怒るし……。 　相変わらずこの子は難しい子ですね」
童心 「まぁまぁ、まぁ。 　久々に四公方が顔をそろえたのでござる」
童心 「今日のところは、再会を祝いましょうぞ」
獅子吼 「宜しかろう。 　これも政治というものだ」
獅子吼 「目出度めでたい」
雷蝶 「そうね」
茶々丸 「こいつら実は、人の上に立つ器量とか全然 無いんじゃなかろうか」
童心 「まぁまぁ。 　…………やれやれ」
童心 「して、茶々丸殿。 　お伺いしたいのでござるが」
茶々丸 「うん？」
獅子吼 「あぁ。俺も訊きたかった。 　……誰だ？　そいつは」

en.html:
Kageaki"............"
Chachamaru"Yes, introduction required. Newly appointed deputy to apun: Lieutenant Colonel Kageaki Minato."
Kageaki"—Minato. I trust you will remember the name."
童心"...Oh..."
Raichou"...Lieutenant Colonel?"
Chachamaru"Be nice, no?"
獅子吼"No, wait. Minato...? Was there such a field officer?"
獅子吼"I do not remember one."
Chachamaru"Naturally."
獅子吼"Former posting?"
Chachamaru"None. Civilian until yesterday."
獅子吼"............Then how is he a lieutenant colonel today!?"
Chachamaru"Well, you know. That business."
獅子吼"What business?"
Chachamaru"Fabrication. Military record, various things."
獅子吼"You announce it openly!"
Chachamaru"Cannot help it. Begin with preparatory school, how many years before apun can use him? At a time like this, who has that leisure?"
Raichou"Even so, such an irresponsible arrangement! Honestly, you always—"
Raichou"Said it automatically, but thinking about it, you did not often make such outrageous appointments, did you?"
Chachamaru"Never met someone worth making an outrageous appointment for. Meet one, different business."
獅子吼"Hmph... Bold claim. This is such a man?"
獅子吼"Well, you called Minato. Your keeper seems to value you highly...?"
Kageaki"........................"
獅子吼"..."
獅子吼"Ignoring me. Considerable nerve."

童心 「……ほゥ……」
雷蝶 「……中佐？」
茶々丸 「よろしくねー」

茶々丸 「そこはそれ。あれだ」
獅子吼 「どれだ」
茶々丸 「捏造。軍歴とか。色々」
獅子吼 「堂々と言う事か！」

雷蝶 「だからって、そんないい加減な話はないで しょうよ！ 　まったくあんたは、いつもいつも――」

獅子吼 「どうなのだ、湊斗とやら。 　飼い主は貴様の事を随分と買っているよう だが……？」
景明 「……………………」
獅子吼 「……」
獅子吼 「黙殺か。 　良い度胸だな」

Kageaki"To receive your praise is an honor, Your Excellency."

獅子吼"...Hmph. Meaning, you are telling me—"
獅子吼"Do not ask an unintelligent question."
Kageaki"Your perception commands my admiration, Lieutenant General Ootori."
童心"............"
Raichou"............"
獅子吼"————————"
獅子吼"Not bad."
Kageaki"..."
獅子吼"Not bad at all... this man."

獅子吼"Not bad."

獅子吼"Not bad. Kageaki Minato... was it? Lieutenant Colonel."
Kageaki"Yes. I am grateful for your remembrance, Your Excellency."
獅子吼"Hmph. Insolent. Not bad. Every word irritates... a thoroughly annoying man."
獅子吼"Kukukukuku..."
Raichou"...Frightening. Your tastes are peculiar in their own way also."
獅子吼"From you alone, I do not wish to hear that. But Chachamaru, which mountain produced this man for you?"
Chachamaru"The mountain belonging to Mr. Overthrow-the-Shogunate."
Raichou"Oi, oi."
獅子吼"Oh. A former rebel."
獅子吼"Does not look one to bend his principles readily. How did you persuade him?"
Chachamaru"Nothing much. Never particularly for or against the shogunate. Circumstances just made him fight it frequently."
Chachamaru"Adjusted the interests of him and our side, brought him over."
獅子吼"Interests. Some private purpose, then?"
Chachamaru"Well, yes. But secret."
獅子吼"Trustworthy?"
Chachamaru"About as much as apun?"
獅子吼"I see."
Raichou"Not 'I see'! As much as this one means no trust at all!"
獅子吼"Exactly. But... no matter."
獅子吼"Nobody here can be trusted anyway. ...Hm? In that case, was that another foolish question?"

Kageaki"Your own assessment should serve, Your Excellency."
獅子吼"Kukukuku...!"
獅子吼"Chachamaru, give me this man. One battalion in exchange."

Chachamaru"Nooo."
